target.discovery: Reach IEDScout-like MMS discovery efficiency without sacrificing exact IEC 61850 model evidence.
target.model: Build the canonical IEC 61850 model from structure-first MMS evidence with correct LN identity, DO/SDO hierarchy, FC ownership, DataSet/RCB semantics, and schema-aware CDC handling.
target.scl: Save Edition 2 IID / Edition 1 ICD that reopens in ARSAS, reconnects to the relay, and is usable as trusted SCL.

iedScoutCapture.note: Reference capture supplied by the physical comparison; values are acceptance reference, not CI-simulated proof.

rejectedLegacyArsasCapture.note: Regression signature. A future field build showing this pattern is rejected.

discoveryAcceptance.typeStrategy: LN/root structure first, bounded leaf fallback only when exact structure evidence is unavailable.
discoveryAcceptance.physicalPerformanceGate: Compare request count, GVA count, Read count, peak outstanding calls, TTFI and total discovery time against IEDScout on the same relay.

modelAcceptance.edition1TrackingDowngrade: omit with explicit warning; never emit invalid Edition 1 SCL
modelAcceptance.mmsTypeDeclarationOrder: LN-root TypeSpecification declaration order is authoritative through model, SCL and FC-root projection.
modelAcceptance.settingFunctionalConstraints: SG/SE are setting data; only actual SGCB produces SettingControl.
modelAcceptance.mhaiThdProjection: MHAI ThdA/ThdPhV are WYE with CMV phase SDOs.

sclAcceptance.initialTrustedSclReads: safe bounded SCL-guided reads after trusted-SCL reconnect; multi-DO CF groups use DO-scoped structured Reads because SCL LNodeType order is not authoritative for MMS FC-root DO order.
sclAcceptance.rcbProjection: 34 runtime RCB -> 32 logical ReportControl; ConfReportControl max=34
sclAcceptance.reuseTransportAndReportingLock: Both Edition 2 and Edition 1 must match 32/32 MMS domains, complete all planned safe FC-root Reads without transport failures, preserve both static DataSets, arm exactly the configured Analog/Digital report plans, resolve all 58 runtime points, and observe actual InformationReport traffic.
sclAcceptance.semanticProjectionTarget: projectionErrors=0 and projected leaf cache has no case-collapse loss.

requiredEvidence: Ed2 SCL-assisted reuse diagnostic with projectionErrorSamples
Ed1 SCL-assisted reuse diagnostic with projectionErrorSamples
promotion.note: Historical R10 physical evidence remains valid for the effective field artifact that included the build-time smart-route transform. This candidate promotes that transform into normal source and also changes live static-report orchestration, so fresh physical acceptance is mandatory before merge or publication.

legacyPolicy.rule: Historical PRs may remain as provenance only; they must not be used as new branch bases after an active convergence authority supersedes them.

testedArtifact.provenanceCorrection: The app commit identifies the repository revision, but the physically tested field artifact also included the workflow build transform above. Commit/tree equality alone is not sufficient to identify equivalent discovery behavior.

trustedSclProjectionParity.rule: Do not classify SCL reuse as semantically converged until projectionErrors reaches zero on both editions. Successful MMS Reads alone are insufficient.
trustedSclProjectionParity.rootCause: R9 PCAP + Ed2 IID reproduction matched all 46 physical errors: every mismatch is in CF, across 18 FC roots / 191 affected SCL leaves, caused by cross-DO positional ordering differences between SCL LNodeType order and the MMS CF structure. No SCL count= arrays are present.
trustedSclProjectionParity.sourceRepair: For multi-DO CF groups, InitialFcReadPlanner now emits exact LN$CF$DO targets. InitialFcValueProjector projects each DO value directly, eliminating cross-DO positional mapping while retaining batching.
trustedSclProjectionParity.note: R9 historical 46/46 evidence is retained for provenance; R10 physically proves the repair on both editions.

edition2CaseDistinctInitialValueCache.rule: LTRK t and T and any other case-distinct IEC 61850 paths must remain separate through TypeSpecification mapping, initial projection, ARSAS cache, canonical instance evidence, DAI/Val export and reopen. cacheLoss must be zero.
edition2CaseDistinctInitialValueCache.sourceRepair: ARSAS trusted-SCL initial-value cache now uses StringComparer.Ordinal. Engine canonical value dedup, TypeSpecification member resolution, and canonical SCL instance-value targeting are exact-case. Diagnostics expose projectedUniqueValues and cacheLoss.
edition2CaseDistinctInitialValueCache.note: R9 historical loss=11 is retained for provenance; R10 physically proves exact-case cache preservation.

preallocatedAddReportControls.rule: Do not invent datSet. rptID-backed singleton runtime names ending 01 must project to indexed logical ReportControl max=1; an unassigned indexed slot is a warning, not a fatal missing-DataSet error.
preallocatedAddReportControls.note: Unassigned indexed ADD slots remain without invented datSet and no longer block reuse/reporting.

saveTimeInstanceValues.rule: Keep structural discovery read-free; acquire bounded safe FC-root values only during explicit Save SCL and verify resulting instance evidence physically.
saveTimeInstanceValues.note: Save-time value enrichment is physically proven. More Val elements than IEDScout is not treated as automatically better; exact semantic path/value comparison remains open.

templateReuse.rule: Reduce duplicate LNodeType/DOType/DAType templates only after wire and semantic reuse parity is stable.
templateReuse.acceptance: Intern only structurally and semantically identical templates. Expanded 32/119/860/906/4925 model, FC ownership, values and round-trip behavior must remain unchanged.

saveEnrichmentReuse.observation: Ed2 and Ed1 saves in one unchanged live session both produced instanceEvidence=3854; the bounded enrichment snapshot can be reused across edition serializers when association/model generation is unchanged.
saveEnrichmentReuse.rule: Do not cache across reconnect, model-generation change, or explicit refresh. Optimization must not alter P0 discovery.

p0StructuralDiscoveryFreeze.scope: AA1E1F06R4 physical acceptance plus source/CI freeze. Counts are evidence and gates for this relay, not generic hardcoded runtime behavior for other IEDs.
p0StructuralDiscoveryFreeze.rule: Do not optimize or enrich structural discovery further while SCL semantic convergence is still open. Any required instance-value acquisition belongs to explicit Save SCL or trusted-SCL reconnect phases.

p1ProjectionOrderRepair.rule: Never use SCL LNodeType cross-DO order as authority for an MMS multi-DO CF structure. Read each CF DataObject by exact MMS object name and batch those references with the existing bounded Read executor.
